verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents board approvals built into its workflows, award agreements tied to the corresponding board consent, and an option grant flow that defaults to FMV pricing (you must opt in to price above or below FMV). 409A valuations are offered through third-party providers, and Gusto offer-letter promises can be granted automatically. However, no evidence shows the 409A value feeding the strike price inside a single new-hire grant workflow, and 409A is a Growth-plan feature delivered via third parties. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a single end-to-end new-hire option grant flow, a documented 409A-to-strike-price link, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow

citations.quote: Board and stockholder approvals are automatically integrated into every relevant workflow in the platform.
